request.description:
This endpoint allows you to add a familiar member for a user. The HTTP POST request should be made to {{UMH Local}}api/msusers/add_familiar.

### Request Body

The request body should be in raw format and include the following parameters:

- `uid` (string): The ID of the user for whom the familiar member is being added.
    
- `Member` (array): An array containing the details of the familiar member to be added, including:
    - `email` (string): The email address of the familiar member.
        
    - `name` (string): The name of the familiar member.
        
    - `phone` (string): The phone number of the familiar member.
        
    - `relationship` (string): The relationship of the familiar member with the user.
        

### Response

The response to the request will include the status of the operation, along with any relevant message or error information.

### Register Distribution

This endpoint is used to register a distribution by making an HTTP POST request to {{UMH Local}}api/msdistributions/register_distribution.

#### Request Body

- `uid` (string, required): The unique identifier of the user.
    
- `Distribution` (array, required): An array containing distribution details.
    - `distributionTo` (string, required): The recipient of the distribution.
        
    - `distributionAmmount` (string, required): The amount of distribution.
        
    - `distributionReason` (string, required): The reason for the distribution.
        

#### Response

The response will contain the status of the distribution registration, along with any relevant information or error messages.

### Register Task

This endpoint is used to register a new task.

#### Request Body

- `uid` (string, required): The user ID.
    
- `Task` (array, required): An array of tasks containing the following parameters:
    - `taskName` (string, required): The name of the task.
        
    - `taskDescription` (string, required): The description of the task.
        
    - `taskFileURL` (string, optional): The URL of the file related to the task.
        
    - `taskCompleted` (boolean, required): Indicates whether the task is completed.
        

#### Response

The response for this request is a JSON object with the following properties:

- `status` (string): Indicates the status of the request.
    
- `message` (string): A message providing additional information about the request status.
    

Example:

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Task registered successfully"
}

 ```

#### JSON Schema for Response

``` json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "status": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string"
    }
  }
}

 ```

### Register Legacy Contact

This endpoint allows you to register a legacy contact by providing the necessary details.

#### Request Body

- `uid` (string, required): The user ID associated with the legacy contact.
    
- `Legacy` (array, required): An array containing the details of the legacy contact.
    - `legacyEmail` (string, required): The email address of the legacy contact.
        
    - `legacyFullName` (string, required): The full name of the legacy contact.
        
    - `legacyPIN` (string, required): The PIN of the legacy contact.
        
    - `legacyPhone` (string, required): The phone number of the legacy contact.
        

#### Response

The response will contain the status of the registration process.

request.description:
This endpoint allows you to update distribution information using an HTTP PATCH request. The request should be sent to {{UMH Local}}api/msdistributions/update_distribution.

### Request Body
- `uid` (string): The unique identifier of the user.
- `distributionID` (string): The identifier of the distribution to be updated.
- `NewInformation` (object): An object containing the updated distribution information.
  - `distributionTo` (string): The recipient of the distribution.
  - `distributionAmmount` (number): The updated amount of the distribution.
  - `distributionReason` (string): The reason for the distribution update.
  - `distributionRelationShip` (string): The relationship associated with the distribution.

### Response
Upon successful execution, the response will have a status code of 200 and a JSON object with a `message` key indicating the outcome of the update operation.
